dimensions.name: age_min
dimensions.description: Inclusive lower age bound (interview-time roster age).
dimensions.notes: Age is topcoded: 80 in 2003-04, 85 from 2005 onward.

dimensions.name: age_max
dimensions.description: Inclusive upper age bound (interview-time roster age).
dimensions.notes: Age is topcoded: 80 in 2003-04, 85 from 2005 onward.

dimensions.name: sex
dimensions.description: Respondent sex from the ATUS household roster (TESEX).

dimensions.name: employment_status
dimensions.description: ATUS-interview labor force status (TELFS): employed {1,2}, unemployed {3,4}, not_in_labor_force {5}.

dimensions.name: has_household_children
dimensions.description: Any household child under 18 present (TRCHILDNUM > 0). Household children, not necessarily own children.

dimensions.name: region
dimensions.description: Census region at the CPS interview (GEREG): 1 Northeast, 2 Midwest, 3 South, 4 West.
dimensions.notes: Measured 2-5 months before the diary day.

dimensions.name: state_fips
dimensions.description: Two-digit state FIPS code at the CPS interview (GESTFIPS), e.g. '06' for California.
dimensions.notes: Measured 2-5 months before the diary day.

dimensions.name: education_level
dimensions.description: Educational attainment at the CPS interview (PEEDUCA), grouped.
dimensions.notes: Measured 2-5 months before the diary day; missing education is excluded when this filter is used.

dimensions.name: day_type
dimensions.description: Diary day of week: weekend = Saturday/Sunday. Estimates then represent the average such day.

dimensions.name: diary_date_min
dimensions.description: Inclusive lower bound on the diary date (YYYY-MM-DD) for within-year period estimates.

dimensions.name: diary_date_max
dimensions.description: Inclusive upper bound on the diary date (YYYY-MM-DD).

missing_data_rule: Filtering on a dimension excludes respondents whose value is missing for that dimension (from numerator and denominator alike); missing is never treated as 'no'. Unfiltered dimensions include everyone.
default_universe: U.S. civilian noninstitutional population age 15 and over (the ATUS target population).
